description: WP-G3 Codex: Orks (11e) PULSE JET (Wazdakka Gutsmek) end to end through the UI. Fixture ork11e_g3_pulse: Custodian Guard B stands 4" in front of Wazdakka. Command phase: a real click on End Command Phase starts the Battle-shock step, whose window offers Full Throttle — a real click on its 'Pulse Jet' variant. Movement phase: a real click on Wazdakka, then on the new 'Pulse Jet (18" + D6)' button — pulse roll, cap 18" + roll, mode locked. A real board drag carries Wazdakka 18.5" straight across the Custodians' bases; a real click on 'End This Unit's Move' confirms it: moved, cannot charge / start an action, and attacks that target Wazdakka have -1 to hit (RulesEngine aggregator source 'Pulse Jet').

steps.comment: End Command Phase: no unit needs a battle-shock test, so ending the phase starts the Battle-shock step, which opens battle_shock_step_start first
the rest of the battle-shock window is not under test
a window not under test (if any) is declined
cap = 18" + pulse roll (one D6), mode locked
the drag below crosses Custodian Guard B's bases (a normal move could not)
the real drag staged Wazdakka beyond the Custodians
opponent's windows / overwatch — not under test

steps.script:
var m = GameState.get_unit("U_WAZDAKKA_GUTSMEK_A").models[0]
return float(m.position.y) > 1000.0 and not RulesEngine.is_unit_engaged("U_WAZDAKKA_GUTSMEK_A", GameState.state)
